segments.title: Sign in as anyone. No IdP.
segments.sub: Personas live in .agnt.kdl. The dev proxy serves the OIDC issuer — here over the tailnet, from a build box.

segments.title: One block. Every role.
segments.sub: Persona chip · :as in the overlay · devauth for agents — github.com/standardbeagle/agnt

segments.text: Declare test users once, in the project's agnt config.
The app signs in through agnt's dev issuer. Over the tailnet, agnt asks Tailscale who you are, and offers only the personas you're allowed.
Signed in as the standard user.
To check the admin view, switch persona from the indicator. The app signs in again, as admin.
Agents get the same switch through the devauth tool.
